newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher led by banking stocks.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher led by banking stocks.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index moved higher again on Thursday with the index's three biggest banking issues Komercni Banka, Ceska Sporitelna and IPB leading the way.
The PX50 rose 0.36 percent to 560.7 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares gained 0.3 percent to 1,177.2.

Dealers said it was coincidental that the three major banking shares had all moved up together on Thursday but said it was noteworthy that some buying interest had returned to the country's biggest savings bank Ceska Sporitelna.
"Sporitelna has recently not been very active and trading volumes have been low," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
Sporitelna rose six crowns to 326. Vystavel said that ING rated Sporitelna a long-term buy at current prices.

Komercni Banka, the country's largest commercial bank, defied predictions from dealers on Wednesday that it was overpriced and added a further nine crowns to close at 2,459. IPB Banka gained 10 crowns to 335.
Taken together the three banks account for around 20 percent of the PX50 index's total capitalisation.
Elsewhere among the blue chips, SPT Telecom lost 15 crowns to 3,385 and CEZ fell seven crowns to 1,067.
